resources.string: Folium only lists PDF files. Pick a folder that contains some, or add PDFs to this one.
%1$d of the files here could not be listed.
Choose a folder to read from
Folium lists the PDFs in one folder you pick. Your files stay on this device and are never uploaded.
Folium lost access to this folder
Android withdrew permission for the folder you chose. Pick it again to restore your library.
The app that provides this folder is unavailable. It may be disabled, or the storage may be disconnected.
That folder is no longer there
The folder you chose has been moved or deleted. Pick it again, or choose a different one.
This folder could not be read
The storage app described this folder in a way Folium could not interpret.
The storage app describes its files in a format Folium does not support. Choose a different folder.
Something stopped Folium partway through. This is usually temporary.
Folium could not open the files in this folder. Check that the storage is still available.
Permission to read it was withdrawn.
The app providing it is unavailable.
It is no longer in this folder.
Its details were missing or unreadable.
It is described in an unsupported format.
